mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO email_verifications (email, code_hash, expires_at, attempt_count, last_sent_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, 0, #{lastSentAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, code_hash, expires_at, verified_at, attempt_count, last_sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verifications SET code_hash = #{codeHash}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, verified_at = NULL, attempt_count = 0, last_sent_at = #{lastSentAt} WHERE id = #{id}
